license_declaration.product_identity_note: Per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md §2.1's per-book override note: within Bestiary 1 itself, classic SRD monster species names (e.g. "Ankheg", "Dark Creeper") are presumptively Open Game Content, not Product Identity, matching the original d20 SRD's declaration -- this book's monster `name`/`id` fields are therefore classified OGL, not PI, unlike a non-bestiary context where a named creature could be PI. Named deities, unique NPCs, and unique places would still be Product Identity if present; none were found in this book's free-text `description` fields during this pass.

screening_method_note: This book's 169 records reached disk through THREE screening passes, and this note states all three rather than implying fewer. PASS 1 -- cycle E2.0.9, 2026-07-27 -- covered the 45 records then on disk (41 monster + 4 equipment): a heuristic first-pass screen against a bounded, documented term list (the 20 canonical Golarion core deity names) run over every free-text `description` value in those records. The 41 monster records carry no free-text field at all -- only mechanical stat-block fields, verified by enumerating all data keys across all 41 monster/*.json -- so pass 1 had exactly 4 equipment `description` values to run over. PASS 2 covered the 119 records added on 2026-07-31 by `src/bin/ingest_races.rs` (11 race chassis + 108 standard racial traits): that binary runs a WIDER 54-term scan -- the same 20 deities plus 34 Golarion place and nation names -- over each record's `key`, `name` and `description`, and aborts the ingest with an error on any hit, so a record cannot reach disk unscreened. PASS 3 -- SD28-E16 subset 09, 2026-08-07 -- covered the 5 monster records added by `src/rules_core/rules_tables/beastiary1/monster_subset_09.rs` (Lion, Ogre, Pegasus, Rust Monster, Shadow): verified by enumerating all `data` keys across all 5 new monster/*.json that none carries a free-text field either, the same `MonsterStatBlock` shape as every prior monster (name/challenge_rating/size/speed_ft/race_type/race_subtype/source_page/natural_attacks -- all short mechanical fields, no prose), so this pass had zero free-text values to screen. Zero matches were found in any of the three passes. `records_processed` is now derived at generation time from the real on-disk count (`gen_cache_beastiary.rs`'s `count_on_disk_records`/`resync_license_record_count`, SD28-E16, mirroring `sd27_gen_book_cache.rs`'s own derivation fix for ARG/PU) rather than hand-typed, so a future content addition cannot leave this field stale the way this one was found stale (164 stated, 169 real) before this pass corrected it. It is NOT an exhaustive human legal review, and no claim of exhaustive PI-freedom is made beyond: no substring match against the documented term lists was found.
